summary: Web UI skeleton: sessions, new-session dialog, event stream rendering
epic_summary: WS-D Web UI (sessions, chat stream, plan, tool calls, diffs, approvals)
description:
Contracts: docs/02-architecture.md. `frontend/`: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind. Think "coding-agent app" (Claude Code desktop / Codex web style): left sessions sidebar, centre chat, right panel tabs Plan / Diff / Run.

## Do

* New-session dialog: repo (rtems, rtems-lwip, ...), environment (Local sandbox; Cloud disabled with "coming soon"), mode (interactive / autonomous), merge policy (human / agent-after-approval / agent), model profile.
* Render every event type in the contract: streaming message, plan todos, collapsible tool call + result, terminal block for `sandbox.exec`, diff viewer, approval card with Approve/Reject, artifact links, usage meter (USD/tokens).
* Talk to the API via `VITE_API_URL`; SSE with reconnect.
* Component tests with Vitest; a fixture file of contract events lives only under `src/__tests__/`.

## Acceptance

* `npm test` green; screenshot of the fixture rendered in the PR; against the live API (once ANVIL Copilot story merges) a session can be created.
